items.title: GOV-FANOUT-1 H2 REDESIGN: STEPS_PER_EP exposure sweep decoupled from F1-firing count (replaces confounded V3-EXQ-853)
items.note: GOV-FANOUT-1 H2 leg, REDESIGNED. Fanout source failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-794a_2026-07-31.json, target v3_exq_794a_..._20260724T063301Z_v3. This replaces the just-failed V3-EXQ-853 leg (script v3_exq_850_mech204_sd076_h2_exposure_budget_probe.py) per failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-853_2026-08-01.md's own routing (section 9, user-confirmed 2026-08-01): a redesign of H2's manipulated axis, not a new hypothesis and not a lettered bugfix of 853's numbers. CONFOUND FIXED: 853 raised N_TRAIN_EPS 30->150 (5x) to test more waking exposure, but SleepLoopManager fires the F1/REM recalibration cycle once per episode (K=1), so raising N_TRAIN_EPS ALSO raised the F1-firing count 30->150 in lockstep -- confounding H2's exposure axis with the sibling H1 leg's (V3-EXQ-850) recalibration-count axis. 853's own autopsy section 6 ("The design confound") specifies the fix: vary STEPS_PER_EP (episode length) instead, which raises total exposure without touching firing count. THE REDESIGN: N_TRAIN_EPS held at 794a's original 30 (F1 fires exactly 30 times, matching 794a and the sibling H1 leg exactly, decoupled from this leg's axis); STEPS_PER_EP raised 200->1000 (5x) for the training phase only (eval phase kept at 794a's original 200, unchanged, since the decisive readout rv_final is read at the END of training before eval begins -- mirroring 853's own precedent of not scaling eval). MULTIPLIER JUSTIFICATION: chosen for exact total-training-step parity with 853's own budget -- N_TRAIN_EPS(30) x STEPS_PER_EP(1000) = 30000 waking steps, identical to 853's N_TRAIN_EPS(150) x STEPS_PER_EP(200) = 30000 -- so this run and 853 test the SAME SIZE exposure increase via two different mechanisms (episode length vs. episode count) and are directly comparable; any difference in outcome is attributable to the confound (F1 firing 30x here vs 150x in 853) rather than to a difference in how much exposure was tested. Same LO=0.6/HI=0.8 asymmetry doses, F1/REM recalibration held ON unchanged, Phase 7 broadcast OFF throughout (not this leg's axis) -- identical operating point to 794a/853/850-h1 otherwise. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): reanalysis_query.py query --readout rv_final --claim SD-076 (2026-08-01) finds 4 manifests (v3_exq_794, v3_exq_794a, v3_exq_850_h1_f1_damping_probe, v3_exq_850_h2_exposure_budget_probe/V3-EXQ-853) -- NONE vary STEPS_PER_EP; every one held it at 794a's original 200. The decisive readout (rv_final under a STEPS_PER_EP-varied, F1-count-matched-to-794a exposure manipulation) exists in no recorded manifest and is not derivable from the four by reanalysis (none isolate the exposure axis from the firing-count axis). Not recoverable -> run. RE-DERIVE BRAKE (Step 2.5b): standard grep-count over failure_autopsy_*.json for SD-076 = 0 genuinely-braking autopsies (853's own recommended_epistemic_category is measurement_test_design_defect, not substrate_ceiling; recommended_evidence_direction is weakens, not non_contributory; re_derive_brake.fired=false, prior_substrate_ceiling_autopsies=[]). Brake does not fire -> proceed. Additionally exempt on its own terms as a GOV-FANOUT-1 discrimination leg explaining WHY a confounded design read the way it did (not a same-axis re-test of an already-braked design -- this is a design-axis swap, verified a "major redesign" per CLAUDE.md's EXQ-versioning rule, hence a new number V3-EXQ-860 rather than V3-EXQ-853b). claim_ids=[SD-076] only, matching 853/850-h2 -- Phase 7 broadcast never engaged, F1 recalibration held constant/unmanipulated, so no MECH-204 evidence in either direction. COMPUTE-TIME PARITY: per-cell total step count (train 30x1000=30000 + eval 20x200=4000 = 34000) is IDENTICAL to 853's own per-cell total (150x200 + 20x200 = 34000); same 6 cells (2 arms x 3 seeds); so estimated wall time matches 853's own 140-minute estimate (if anything marginally faster: 30 sleep-cycle firings vs 853's 150, ~5% less overhead against the same 34000-step main budget -- 140min kept as the safe, not optimistic, figure). Code review (Step 3.5): full pass completed -- claim tagging re-verified (SD-076 only, unchanged reasoning from 853), substrate API re-verified against current ree-v3 source (E3TrajectorySelector._running_variance/._wci_symmetric_rv_ref, agent.sleep_loop, mech204_recalibration_fired/running_variance_before/after writeback keys, REEConfig.e3 waking_confidence_* fields all confirmed present 2026-08-01), DV-symmetry invariance declared per arm in the module docstring, diagnostic adjudication preconditions/criteria_non_degenerate/load_bearing tags carried forward unchanged in shape from 853. TWO GAPS FOUND IN THE 853 TEMPLATE AND FIXED HERE (not present in this run's predecessor): (1) 853 never printed a per-seed-condition "verdict: PASS/FAIL" progress line at all (skill Step 3 progress-instrumentation rule #3) -- added here as a per-cell proxy (rv moved toward the smoke reference vs. not), mirroring the sibling H1 leg's own precedent; this is a runner-display fix only, not a scientific-verdict change. (2) 853 never wired z_goal_stream_stats into write_flat_manifest (skill Step 4 "z_goal liveness recorded?") -- wired here via ZGoalStreamAccumulator, again mirroring the H1 sibling; this run does not manipulate goal state, so an unmeasured/zero reading is the expected, correctly-recorded result. Smoke --dry-run PASS (4 cells at toy scale, all progress-instrumentation lines present and correctly formatted). validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 findings, OK. supersedes V3-EXQ-853 (queue_id form; the manifest's own supersedes field carries the superseded run_id v3_exq_850_mech204_sd076_h2_exposure_budget_probe_20260801T005937Z_v3, per CLAUDE.md's per-artifact supersedes-field split). Time-sensitive: EVB-0454's SD-076 decision deadline is 2026-08-03T20:50:36Z (~2 days); user confirmed queuing regardless of whether it lands before the deadline (autopsy section 9).

items.title: ARC-062/MECH-309 diagnostic: lateral_pfc route_source vs none ablation, MECH-448/449 engagement
items.note: ARC-062/MECH-309 targeted diagnostic (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-851_2026-08-01.md, user-confirmed routing): V3-EXQ-851 found MECH-448 (F-eligibility demotion) and MECH-449 (active Go/No-Go) BOTH collapse from robustly-live (654j, same seeds: 17.76 / 1.549) to EXACTLY 0.0 when modulatory_channel_route_source switches from "cand_world_summary" to "lateral_pfc", under IDENTICAL seeds (42/43/44) and identical USE_F_ELIGIBILITY_DEMOTION=True/USE_GO_NOGO_CONSTITUTION=True flags -- a deterministic same-seed collapse, not seed variance. Autopsy routing: a CHEAP ablation comparing route_source="lateral_pfc" vs "none" (channel_route_bias stays None per ree_core/agent.py elif-chain fallthrough -- confirmed by inspection, ~line 7454) at the SAME seeds, tracking ONLY MECH-448/449 engagement, BEFORE spending another ~7.7h on the same full falsifier design blind. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = MECH-448/449 engagement under lateral_pfc-vs-none route_source at matched seeds. Checked: V3-EXQ-851 tested lateral_pfc alone (route was a matched CONSTANT there, not swept; the swept var was use_candidate_rule_field) with no none comparator in the same run; V3-EXQ-654j tested a DIFFERENT route_source (cand_world_summary), not this none ablation. Not recoverable by reanalysis -> proceed to author. Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): claim_ids=[]; per the autopsys own re_derive_brake field, fired=false, prior_substrate_ceiling_autopsies=[] (0 -- this autopsys own category is measurement_test_design_defect, not substrate_ceiling). Brake does not apply. Scope (deliberately minimal, NOT the full 851/654j falsifier apparatus per the autopsys own routing instruction): 2 arms (ARM_LPFC route_source=lateral_pfc vs ARM_NONE route_source=none), use_candidate_rule_field=True on BOTH arms (matched constant, unlike 851 where CRF on/off was the swept var), all other matched-stack levers (env, MECH-448/449 floor/adaptive-mean-factor constants, modulatory selection authority gain/basis, channel routing, CRF maturity/maintenance levers, SD-056 online e2 training) identical to 851/654j. NO P1 phase (structural engagement question, not a trained-bias behavioural question). Readout = ONLY the raw MECH-448 (f_eligibility_demotion_active_frac + mean excluded_count) and MECH-449 (go_nogo_active_frac + mean safety+soft suppressions) quantities, reusing 851s own attribute names/read paths off agent.e3.last_score_diagnostics, latch-cleared on EVERY tick (agent.e3.last_score_diagnostics=None immediately before every select_action call; collected only on genuine fresh-select ticks -- unlike 851s own C1e/f which deliberately stay bit-identical to 654js held/latched calibration, every read here is latch-cleared). No C1(a-d)/C1(g) readiness gates, no C2 committed-class entropy, no DV-symmetry declaration, no declared-null three-branch grid, no arm-reuse/baseline-module machinery. One minimal readiness precondition (p2_fresh_select_sample_adequate_both_arms, the cadence-derived min-fresh-select floor) gates outcome=FAIL/substrate_not_ready_requeue if the sample is too thin to trust; otherwise outcome=PASS with an interpretation label stating whether route_source is confirmed causal, ruled out, or the result is mixed/inconclusive (explicitly distinguishing an under-powered null from a genuine structural finding). claim_ids=[]; experiment_purpose="diagnostic"; evidence_direction="non_contributory" always (cannot support/weaken MECH-309/ ARC-062 by itself). BUDGET (see script docstring BUDGET section for full derivation): P0=10 ep, P2=10 ep (200 steps/ep) -- FAR shorter than 851/654js calibrated P0=200/P1=90/P2=60. An empirical timing probe of the identical matched-stack config on this machine (Mac darwin-arm64, torch 2.12.0; 700 steady-state ticks, warmup excluded) measured ~84ms/tick with NO training overhead -- even matching 851s P0=200 alone would cost hours, directly contradicting the cheap-diagnostic routing. Justification for the shortened P0: MECH-448/449 gate on STRUCTURAL differentiation (F-merit spread, excluded_count>0) and a non-parametric dACC recency-share statistic, NOT on candidate_rule_field/lateral_pfc maturity or trained accuracy (confirmed by code inspection -- neither mechanisms code path in e3_selector.py references agent.candidate_rule_field or agent.lateral_pfc) -- both can show non-trivial structure well before full 654j-style maturation. This is judgment under a hard compute ceiling, not a proof; accepted risk is an under-powered null (both arms read dead), which the scripts own interpretation grid reports as EXPLICITLY inconclusive (mech448_449_live_under_lateral_pfc_route_851_not_replicated_at_this_dose or route_source_ruled_out_collapse_persists_without_routing, distinguished from a confirmed causal finding) rather than silently misreading it as a confident verdict either way. Target wall time ~35-45 min (24000 total env ticks across 6 cells); estimated_minutes set generously since machine_affinity=any. Relevance: this diagnostics result determines whether the currently-SUSPENDED V3-EXQ-858 (a 1200-minute, 4-rung f_weight ladder run reusing the IDENTICAL lateral_pfc-routed + MECH-448/449-active matched-stack config as V3-EXQ-851, GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-B) can safely resume as-is, needs a redesign, or should be held for an /implement-substrate fix -- priority (42) set above the portfolio ordinary diagnostic priority (P-Ds 40) because it gates a suspended 20-hour cloud allocation. Code review (Step 3.5): claim tagging (claim_ids=[] correct for a mechanism-isolation ablation; EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE="diagnostic" correct); diagnostic adjudication (one readiness precondition, measured/threshold/met, load_bearing sample_adequate criterion, criteria_non_degenerate for both mechanisms ablation-discrimination); substrate API correctness (route-source elif chain, f_eligibility_demotion_active/go_nogo_constitution_active/go_nogo_n_safety_nogo/ go_nogo_n_soft_applied/f_eligibility_excluded_count attribute names independently grepped live in e3_selector.py before writing, matching 851s own read paths verbatim); no phased training beyond P0 (P1 correctly skipped per scope); sample-size integrity (latch-clearing verified -- last_score_diagnostics cleared immediately before every select_action call, every MECH-448/449/route-range read gated on fresh_diag is not None); progress instrumentation ([train] ep N/M with M=P0+P2=20 the loop bound, verdict PASS/FAIL per seed*arm = 6 lines, Seed/Condition boundary lines); output contract (run_id _v3, architecture_epoch, outcome exact field, write_flat_manifest stamps recording_schema/substrate_hash/machine/ machine_class/elapsed_seconds/config/seeds, z_goal_stream wired via ZGoalStreamAccumulator); runner conformance (emit_outcome at end of __main__, dry_run threaded through, manifest relocated out of evidence/ on dry-run). Smoke test (--dry-run): both arms x 1 seed complete cleanly, verdict PASS x2, manifest written+cleaned, [smoke] z_goal_stream: no writer defect. validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 non-conforming, 0 findings across all checks after adding ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT for the one live-measurement-count precondition (same exemption shape as V3-EXQ-858s identical precondition). validate_recording.py --strict: OK, 0 always-core gaps, 0 schema warnings (verified on a manifest built via a direct run_experiment()/_build_manifest() call, since --dry-run relocates/deletes its own manifest by design).

items.title: ARC-062 GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-D (H4 diagnostic): context-conditioned (reef vs open) committed-class TV-divergence, ARM_ON vs ARM_OFF
items.note: arc_062_conversion_fanout_2026-07-29.md Section 2 Leg P-D (H4: measurement aliasing). chip chip-20260729-arc062-pd-context-modeswitch. DIAGNOSTIC, claim_ids=[] intentionally empty; brake-exempt (different question from the same-claim P-A retest). PREMISE CORRECTION vs Section 2's literal text (STOP-CHECK, this session): the plan doc's P-D design line names 'gated_policy routing', which Leg P-A's own erratum (same doc, appended 2026-07-31) found does NOT route the rule-apprehension/CRF channel -- modulatory_channel_route_source=gated_policy identity-routes the unrelated GatedPolicy module output (ree_core/agent.py:7414), not LateralPFCAnalog's rule_state. Since that routing would only add an unrelated equally-present-on-both-arms bias term (no bearing on a paired ARM_ON-vs-ARM_OFF comparison), THIS BUILD OMITS IT: script is a straight, code-verified adaptation of the already-run V3-EXQ-654j matched stack (unchanged: MECH-448 demotion + MECH-449 active No-Go both matched-stack constants; swept variable use_candidate_rule_field) plus a NEW context-partitioned readout on the same P2 window. Substrate verification (this session): SD-054 reef/open bipartite geometry is a real, already-used primitive (ree_core/environment/causal_grid_world.py, already in 654j's own ENV_KWARGS); _is_reef_half + _tv_distance ported verbatim from ree-v3/experiments/v3_exq_690_q054_arc062_diversity_floor_sweep.py, which demonstrates the partition is live and non-degenerate on this exact env config (seeds 42/43 both clear a >=10-tick floor in both partitions; seed 44 recorded 0 reef ticks under 690's DIFFERENT policy -- failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-690_2026-06-20.md). New C1g readiness gate (context_scorable on a majority of seeds, both arms) self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue if the partition is not exercisable under 654j's own policy, rather than assuming 690's finding transfers. GOV-REUSE-1: the decisive readout (paired-by-seed TV(committed-class|reef) vs TV(committed-class|open), ARM_ON vs ARM_OFF on the use_candidate_rule_field sweep) is not recorded anywhere -- V3-EXQ-690 already reports the same tv_reef_forage statistic per seed-arm but its swept variable is noise_floor_min_temperature, a different manipulation entirely; not recoverable by reanalysis, proceeds to a new run. DV-symmetry invariance declared in the script docstring: the CRF differentiation is not a broadcast scalar (inherits 654j's own established finding) and TV distance over set-aggregate categorical distributions carries no further arm-dependent symmetry. Declared null (H4 refuted): ARM_ON shows no greater cross-context divergence than ARM_OFF -> the pooled-marginal DV was not aliasing a context-switch; strengthens the H2/H3 reading over a measurement artifact. Declared positive (H4 confirmed): motivates a NEW evidence-purpose re-pose of MECH-309/ARC-062 with the context DV as primary (separate queue entry, not this one). Code review (this session): added a latch-clear (agent.e3.last_score_diagnostics=None immediately before every select_action) + n_latched_ticks counter for the inherited MECH-448/449 diagnostics reads, per the fanout doc's Section 2 preamble mandate and the V3-EXQ-785 ~9x pseudo-replication lesson -- clears validate_experiments.py's stale-e3-diagnostics and hold-weighted-readout WARNs (both present before the fix, both clear after; 654j itself still carries them uncorrected). validate_experiments.py --strict: OK, 0 non-conforming (1 pre-existing advisory anchor-reachability WARN, also present on the unmodified 654j template -- inherited, not new). --dry-run: both arms complete, verdict PASS x2, manifest written+cleaned; C1/C1g correctly read False on the tiny dry-run dose (2 P2 episodes x 30 steps cannot clear the readiness floors -- expected, matches 654j's own dry-run behaviour), confirming the code paths execute without error.

items.title: ARC-062 GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-B (H2: F-dominance) -- f_weight attenuation ladder, committed-class entropy
items.note: ARC-062 GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-B (H2: F-dominance, downstream of selection). Design of record: REE_assembly/evidence/planning/arc_062_conversion_fanout_2026-07-29.md Section 2 Leg P-B + "P-B buildability resolution (2026-07-31)". claim_ids=[] (diagnostic; brake-exempt per fanout doc Section 4 -- P-B tests a different mechanism from Leg P-A, claim-neutral by design; not a re-derive-brake case).  (a) GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = paired-by-seed committed-class entropy across an f_weight attenuation ladder, under the lateral_pfc-routed + CRF-ON + MECH-448/449-active matched-stack config. f_weight did not exist before V3-EXQ-852 (SD-085 landed ree-v3 main 12374fb, 2026-07-31). V3-EXQ-852 itself (ree-v3 995c7db) tested f_weight only under substrate DEFAULTS, not this leg's CRF-ON matched stack; no other manifest sweeps f_weight at all. Not recoverable by reanalysis -> proceed to author.  (b) Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): claim_ids=[], brake-EXEMPT per fanout doc Section 4 ("P-B/P-C/P-D are brake-exempt... P-B tests a different mechanism").  (c) SD-085 landing: ree-v3 main 12374fb ("SD-085: E3Config.f_weight -- weight on F (reality cost) in score_trajectory"). REE_assembly/docs/architecture/ sd_085_e3_reality_cost_weight.md. E3Config.f_weight: float = 1.0 (no-op default), multiplicative coefficient on F in E3TrajectorySelector.score_trajectory (ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py:1190). Set directly post-construction (agent.e3.config.f_weight = X), matching the lambda_ethical/rho_residue sweep idiom -- not wired through REEConfig.from_dims().  (d) CORRECTED route source: this leg's matched stack uses modulatory_channel_route_source="lateral_pfc" (V3-EXQ-851's corrected value, ree-v3 3c5d45a9dd + substrate branch in ree_core/agent.py), NOT the design doc's original literal "gated_policy" text, which V3-EXQ-851's own erratum (design doc, "Erratum (2026-07-31)" section) proved does not route the rule-apprehension/CRF channel at all.  (e) NEW C1(h) F_WEIGHT_KNOB_LIVE gate: on genuine fresh-select P2 ticks (same latch-clearing discipline as C1g), confirms mean_f_weighted falls within a +/-2% interval of f_weight * mean_f_raw (agent.e3._last_traj_components), on a majority of seeds, on EVERY rung -- i.e. the f_weight knob genuinely rescales F through the FULL matched-stack pipeline at every attenuation level, not just at substrate defaults (V3-EXQ-852's scope). C1(a-g) reused verbatim from V3-EXQ-851 (same names/thresholds) but re-scoped from "both arms" to "all four rungs" since CRF is now a matched constant ON everywhere (no OFF arm in this design); C1(d) is necessarily re-expressed as a direct magnitude floor (mean_lateral_pfc_bias_abs > PROP_NONVAC_FLOOR) rather than a paired ON/OFF diff. C1_holds requires all eight sub-gates to hold at majority-of-seeds on EVERY rung. Any C1 fail on any rung -> substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a verdict.  (f) DV-symmetry declaration (mandatory, 604c net): committed-class entropy is a function of the argmax action-class sequence. f_weight rescales ONE per-candidate-VARYING term (F -- not a broadcast scalar) relative to M/Phi in the score sum; neither a uniform additive shift (argmax-cancelling) nor a whole-score monotone rescale -- so it is NOT invariant under the committed-class DV's argmax symmetry and legitimately CAN change the committed argmin, at every rung.  (g) Declared-null three-branch map (NO weakens, claim_ids=[]): (1) any C1(a-h) fails on any rung -> substrate_not_ready_requeue, evidence_direction=unknown. (2) C1 holds on all 4 rungs AND C2 holds (F000-vs-F100 committed-class-entropy lift >= 0.05 nats on >=2/3 seeds) -> f_dominance_confirmed_h2_operative_ceiling, evidence_direction=non_contributory but a load-bearing GOVERNANCE ROUTING signal (ARC-062's behavioural retest should be gated behind an F-rebalance substrate landing). (3) C1 holds AND C2 fails -> f_dominance_refuted_as_sole_cause, evidence_direction=non_contributory; per the fanout doc's P-C resolution, H3 (competence/action-learning) is already "eliminated" in hypothesis_space_registry.v1.json -- this branch corroborates the already-tracked H-observation-interface root rather than reopening H3.  (h) Code review (Step 3.5): full checklist walked against the script -- claim tagging (claim_ids=[] correct for a claim-neutral diagnostic; EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE ="diagnostic" correct); diagnostic adjudication (9 preconditions C1a-h all readiness-kind with measured/threshold/met, load_bearing C2 criterion, criteria_non_degenerate for all 9); substrate API correctness (f_weight, _last_traj_components["f"]/["f_weighted"], and the "lateral_pfc" route branch independently grepped live in ree_core before writing); phased training (P0/P1/ P2 unchanged from 851); sample-size integrity (same latch-clearing idiom as 851/791a -- last_score_diagnostics cleared before every select_action, C1g and the new C1h reads both gated on the SAME fresh-select check since _last_traj_components is populated in the same score_trajectory call); progress instrumentation ([train] ep N/M with M=total_train_eps loop bound, verdict PASS/FAIL per seed*rung = 12 lines, Seed/Condition boundary lines); output contract (run_id _v3, architecture_epoch, outcome exact field, stamp_recording_core via write_flat_manifest, z_goal_stream wired via ZGoalStreamAccumulator per 852's pattern -- an improvement over 851, which leaves it NOT RECORDED); runner conformance (emit_outcome at end of __main__, dry_run threaded through). One finding during review: validate_experiments.py flagged a new anchor-reachability WARN not present on 851 (851 is experiment_purpose="evidence", which the lint skips entirely; this script is correctly "diagnostic" per the locked design, so the identically-shaped C1a-g/h preconditions newly trip it). Resolved with a documented ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT (the preconditions are live-measurement COUNT aggregates, not known-degenerate-reference anchors -- there is no predicate-vs-frozen-reference mismatch to guard against, matching the precedent set by V3-EXQ-852's own exemption reasoning for its one by-construction precondition).  (i) Smoke test (--dry-run): all 4 rungs x 1 seed complete cleanly, verdict PASS x4, manifest written+cleaned. C1/C1h correctly read False on the tiny dry-run dose (2 P2 episodes x 30 steps cannot clear the readiness floors -- expected, matches 851's own dry-run behaviour). Independently verified the C1(h) F_WEIGHT_KNOB_LIVE logic via a direct run_experiment() call: at every rung mean_f_weighted matched f_weight*mean_f_raw within the 2% interval exactly as designed (e.g. ARM_F000 f_weight=0.0 -> mean_f_weighted=0.0 bit-exact; ARM_F100 f_weight=1.0 -> mean_f_weighted==mean_f_raw exactly), confirming the knob-live check computation is correct before the real run. [smoke] z_goal_stream: active_frac=0.000 ticks=0/455 writer_calls=455 goal_state_present=True n_agents=4 -- no writer defect (correctly wired, zero active_frac expected on the tiny dry-run dose).  (j) validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 findings across all 19 checks (0 anchor-reachability-warnings after the ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT addition; 0 arm-fingerprint-backlog; 0 stale-e3-diagnostics; 0 precondition-recomputability; 0 dead-z_goal-stream; matches V3-EXQ-851's own fully-clean state).  Reuses V3-EXQ-851's matched-stack + C1(a-g) + latch-clearing machinery verbatim per the fanout doc's own instruction ("Leg P-B... hold the rule-apprehension channel ON and lateral_pfc-routed... as a matched constant"). One deliberate deviation from 851: the within-class-representative-entropy SECONDARY negative control is dropped -- its framing ("rule bias is class-keyed, cannot move within-class selection") is specific to sweeping use_candidate_rule_field, which is now a matched constant here, not the swept variable; nothing in this leg's design spec depends on it.
